1.t: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion,

2.t: And the earth throws up her burdens (from within),

3.t: And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her?'-

4.t: On that Day will she declare her tidings:

5.t: For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration.

6.t: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done).

7.t: Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it!

8.t: And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it.
